newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.

text.p: U.S. dollar buying, mostly to pay off petroleum import bills, led the Bangladesh taka to close marginally weaker at 42.8450/8500 to the dollar in interbank transactions on Wednesday, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.8480/8500 per dollar in early trade after a large state-owned bank sought a large amount of dollars to cover import payments.
But most deals were done at 42.8460/8480 level, dealers said.
The interbank call money rates finished unchanged at 5.25 to 5.75 percent.
